phase: F11 — Foundation Console session/permission guard for runtime endpoints

doctrine_locked.gateway_is_sole_identity_authority: Gateway strips ALL client-supplied x-fc-* identity headers + cookie before proxying and re-injects sanitized session-derived headers. Client header spoofing is impossible.
